BEGIN	BeginStmt{IsolationLevel="",ReadOnly=false,Deferrable=false}
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE	BeginStmt{IsolationLevel="serializable",ReadOnly=false,Deferrable=false}
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE READ ONLY	BeginStmt{IsolationLevel="serializable",ReadOnly=true,Deferrable=false}
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE, READ ONLY	BeginStmt{IsolationLevel="serializable",ReadOnly=true,Deferrable=false}
BEGIN READ ONLY	BeginStmt{IsolationLevel="",ReadOnly=true,Deferrable=false}
BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE READ ONLY DEFERRABLE	BeginStmt{IsolationLevel="serializable",ReadOnly=true,Deferrable=true}
BEGIN WORK	BeginStmt{IsolationLevel="",ReadOnly=false,Deferrable=false}
CALL p	CallStmt{Name=ObjectName{Schema="",Name="p"},Args=∅,ArgNames=∅}
CALL p()	CallStmt{Name=ObjectName{Schema="",Name="p"},Args=[],ArgNames=∅}
CALL p(1, 2)	CallStmt{Name=ObjectName{Schema="",Name="p"},Args=[IntegerConst{Value=1},IntegerConst{Value=2}],ArgNames=∅}
CALL p(1, b => 2)	CallStmt{Name=ObjectName{Schema="",Name="p"},Args=[IntegerConst{Value=1},IntegerConst{Value=2}],ArgNames=["","b"]}
CALL p(a => 1)	CallStmt{Name=ObjectName{Schema="",Name="p"},Args=[IntegerConst{Value=1}],ArgNames=["a"]}
CALL s.p()	CallStmt{Name=ObjectName{Schema="s",Name="p"},Args=[],ArgNames=∅}
COMMIT	CommitStmt{}
